title: AuditJobPayload
description: What the Go worker posts to the Python AI service for one assessment job (TECH_SPEC §10, refined by R-03/R-07/R-11). Everything the AI service is allowed to know is in this envelope: it receives a FROZEN rule set and an evidence manifest, and returns a ProviderResponse. It cannot query the database, mutate reviews/scores/permissions, or fetch evidence by itself — that is the R-11/§5.2 boundary.

attempt_token.description: Per-lease token. Echoed in the ProviderResponse; a response with a stale token is discarded by Go (worker-crash recovery, cancel safety).

idempotency_key.description: Organization-scoped key binding the operation to this exact payload fingerprint. The same key with a different payload is a 409 conflict, never a silent re-run.

target_locale.description: BCP-47. Decides the perspective of rule checks, not the report language (D-012 draft).

rules_sha256.description: Hash of the exact rule-set file bound to this run (R-03): scoring and comparisons use this snapshot, never the currently active standard.

evidence.description: Only READY evidence appears here. This manifest is the complete input universe: assessments citing ids outside it are grounding failures.

items.description: The frozen applicable-check set (the scoring denominator source, ADR-0002 §2.1): deterministic filtering happened in Go BEFORE this job was created; Python must not re-filter or extend it.

max_provider_requests.description: Hard cap including retries, repairs and fallback (execution plan §6). Exhausting it returns budget_exhausted, not a partial answer.

run_context.description: Informational only. Comparison/retest semantics live in Go and the DB; the AI service must not behave differently based on retest status.
